strings.help.title: Help · WheelMix
strings.help.heading: Using WheelMix
strings.help.mix: Play audio in Discord and a game or music app. Wheel up favors Chat; down favors Game. Reverse the direction in Preferences. Center restores original volumes.
strings.help.headset: The USB receiver can remain connected while the headset is off. WheelMix checks the headset link every few seconds. Without a valid response, it shows an unconfirmed state.
strings.help.guard: The wheel also sends a volume command to Windows. Compensation tries to undo that change after each tick. It does not lock volume or block the command. Brief jumps or interference with simultaneous changes are possible. Diagnostics shows its state and correction count.
strings.help.startup: Select or clear the startup option and Save. This registers the current copy to run in the tray at your next sign-in, or removes its entry. Windows can disable it separately in Startup apps; use the link in Preferences. Moving the executable requires saving the option again.
strings.help.apps: Checked apps are Chat; the rest are Game. Choosing an .exe adds its name without running it or creating an audio output. Apps sharing a process name are grouped. Use desktop Discord to separate it from the browser.
strings.help.tray: Minimize or click X to keep WheelMix running in the tray near the clock (possibly under hidden icons). Double-click its icon to open the window. Exit from that icon restores volumes and closes the app. Pause centers the mix.
strings.startup.off: Not registered: WheelMix will not start at sign-in.
strings.startup.on: Registered as WheelMix to start in the tray at sign-in. Also check that Windows has it enabled.
strings.startup.other: Registered at another location or under the old name. Save with startup enabled to update it.
strings.startup.disabled: Registered, but switched off in Windows Startup apps. Save with startup enabled to turn it back on.
strings.startup.error: Windows did not confirm the startup change.
strings.guard.disabled: Compensation disabled: the wheel also changes Windows volume.
